purpose: A self-heated diode's AC junction rise is one thermal pole, H0/(1 + j*2*pi*f*cth0*R), which ngspice 44.2 and 45 leave out above the 0.673 Hz corner.

oracle.derivation: cjo = tt = 0 leave cth0 the only storage, so v(tj)/v1 = H0/(1 + j*2*pi*f*cth0*R) exactly, H0 = dT/dv1 at v1 = 0.75 V and R = dT/dP for heat P injected into tj, both from ngspice 44.2 DC operating points of this circuit at reltol=1e-12 abstol=1e-18 vntol=1e-15 (ngspice 45 prints the same digits). H0: central differences at dv1 = 1e-5 V (131.79097559113) and 4e-6 V (131.79097518190), Richardson-extrapolated to 131.790975104; ngspice's own AC prints 131.7909751003, agreeing to 3e-11. R: an ideal current source into tj at +-1e-6 W and +-4e-6 W, 236.49700448 and 236.49700451 K/W, mean 236.497004495; cth0*R = 0.236497004495 s. Expected = [Re, Im] of H0/(1 + j*w*cth0*R).
